lines.text: Actually believe in others? Now that's a good joke.
Any missions that are a cakewalk?
Do not worry, Commander, we will protect you.
Let's share a soda next time!
You're the only human that I trust. I'm begging you, don't betray us.
Wanna hang out again? I can be your tour guide.
*Yawn* booorrrring! Sitting around doing nothing is no fun.
Well... I suppose looking at your face isn't so bad.
Splish splash, I'm takin' a bath!
Cleaning the house doesn't actually make it much cleaner...
The air here is nice. Too bad that's the only thing that's nice.
I'm going to be the best, right?
Oh my gosh oh my gosh, is this a gift?
You have my eternal loyalty, Commander.
Well... getting overly attached may be dangerous.
So intense... what are these emotions I'm feeling?
My turn? I suppose I'll have to finish this up.
What should the first target be?
With all this modern technology, reloading seems so obsolete.
